playing.label: 动物 · 玩耍
playing.prompt: A gentle animated woodland party. A squeaky bunny character giggles hee-hee, a chittery squirrel character chuckles rapidly, a low chuffy fox character gives a warm little laugh, and a rounded owl character answers with a hooting giggle. Playful nonverbal cartoon animal acting, recognizable happy laughter with animal timbres. Short turns, quiet gaps and a little soft paw patter. No spoken words, no narration, no human crowd, no music.
playing.negative_prompt: Spoken words, intelligible dialogue, adult human conversation, narration, screaming, singing, music, harsh distortion.

startled.label: 动物 · 受惊
startled.prompt: Friendly cartoon animal characters notice a distant surprise: a bunny gives a tiny high oh-like squeak, a squirrel makes a quick surprised chirrup, an owl gives a questioning hoo, and a chuffy little fox gasps then reassures the others with a small gentle chuckle. Nonverbal animated animal emotion, clear surprise then comfort, not terrifying. Short turns and quiet gaps. No actual words, no screaming, no human conversation, no music.
startled.negative_prompt: Spoken words, intelligible dialogue, adult human conversation, narration, screaming, singing, music, harsh distortion.

reunion.label: 动物 · 团圆
reunion.prompt: A warm reunion of cartoon woodland animal friends. A squeaky little bunny gives a joyful giggle, a trilling raccoon chuckles happily, a soft low fox chuffs a laugh, a squirrel chatters excitedly and a round-voiced owl hoots with delight. Affectionate nonverbal laughter and animal-style cheers that clearly express happiness. Short alternating turns, no endless chorus. No spoken words, no narration, no human crowd, no music.
